about.title: Quality learning should be within reach
about.description: Across Sub-Saharan Africa, many classrooms are large and teachers are stretched thin. Niel Academy is building curriculum-aligned support that students can use day-to-day, starting in Cameroon and expanding over time.

problem.title: A gap we can close
problem.description: Teacher shortages and large class sizes make it hard to give every learner enough attention. UNESCO highlights the scale of the challenge.

founder.title: Built by someone who understands the challenge
founder.story: Othniel Che founded Niel Academy after experiencing firsthand the challenges of learning in under-resourced classrooms. As a software engineer from Mutengene, Cameroon, he built the tutoring system he wished he had as a student - one that understands African curricula and helps students think, not just memorize.
founder.vision: Niel Academy begins with Cameroon but is building curriculum-specific AI learning infrastructure for African education systems. We are not just a GCE application - we are developing the foundation for personalized learning across the continent.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To give every African student access to personalized, curriculum-aligned tutoring that builds understanding and prepares them for academic success.
mission.approach: We focus on three core principles: curriculum alignment with official syllabi, evidence-based learning through mark scheme grading, and adaptive support that meets students where they are.

parents.title: Give your child the support they deserve
parents.description: We know private tutors are expensive and classrooms are overcrowded. Niel Academy is a trustworthy, affordable alternative built specifically for your child's curriculum.

cost.title: A fraction of traditional tutoring
cost.description: Private tutors can be out of reach for many families. Niel Academy makes quality academic support accessible at home every day.

whyAffordability.title: Why affordability matters
whyAffordability.description: When support is affordable, students get consistent help instead of occasional sessions. That consistency is where confidence and results often improve.

actualLearning.question: Will my child actually learn, or just copy answers?
actualLearning.answer: Understanding Mode is designed to prevent passive copying. The AI guides students to reason through problems, and full answers appear when explicitly requested.

safety.question: Is it safe for my child to use?
safety.answer: Niel Academy is strictly an educational tool. It's tuned to stay focused on academic content and be appropriate and encouraging for secondary school students.

internet.question: My child has limited internet. Will it still work?
internet.answer: Yes. Core materials can be downloaded in advance and accessed offline, so studying can continue even when connectivity is unreliable.

alignment.question: Is it aligned to what their school is teaching?
alignment.answer: Yes. Content is built directly from official past papers and structured around the same syllabus students follow in school.
